$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.description: Runtime mode. production arms the default config environment.

vars.name: CONFIG_SECRET_KEY
vars.description: Encrypts stored secrets. Exactly 64 hex characters. Unset: the secrets API answers 503.

vars.name: DATABASE_URL
vars.feeds: connectionUrl (LISTEN for live updates; unset polls)
vars.description: Postgres connection string. On serverless use the pooler URL; migrations take the direct one.

vars.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token guarding the standalone config and secrets routes. Unset: those routes are not mounted. Shared by every brick that has an admin surface.
